```powershell
Write-Output '=== PHI TERMINAL V3 THE LIBRARY 462 - IT READS WHAT HE HAS, BY THEIR NAMES, IN SECTIONS (Ground from Tyree, 2026-10-28, assembled whole: the panel should be able to add any game basically, with their names, like it reads what I got, like a mod thing they show what available games, sections, phi reverse engineer Wand. The Wand form is the library: the games a player owns, detected on the machine, shown by their real display names in sections, one click to the game page and its toggles. V3 builds that form in phi. One, this job first builds the catalog on the machine itself: Xbox and Store packages with their manifest display names, Steam libraries read from libraryfolders and appmanifests, Epic manifests with display name install location and launch executable, and the EA Games folder, written as name source process installpath rows to games txt in the PhiTerminal folder with per source counts printed. Two, it decodes the v3 source, carried in this file as base64 immune to every quoting gate, and compiles it over the same PhiTerminal exe: a sectioned library window, RUNNING NOW XBOX STEAM EPIC EA OTHER CUSTOM, that reads the catalog, marks what runs by process name and by install path, attaches from the list or the foreground, carries the add any game shelf that persists to custom games txt, seats the online stand down, and keeps Tab and the command line. Three, it closes the standing panel, launches v3 standing, and prints the pid and the log tail. The verdict in one line: LIBRARY STANDS with the game count and the state. Every variable carries the pt462 prefix.) ==='
$pt462dir = 'C:\Users\Admin\PhiTerminal'
$pt462rows = @()
$pt462nXbox = 0; $pt462nSteam = 0; $pt462nEpic = 0; $pt462nEa = 0
function Clean462($pt462s) { if ($null -eq $pt462s) { return '' }; return ($pt462s -replace '[|\r\n]', ' ').Trim() }
try {
  $pt462pkgs = @(Get-AppxPackage -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { -not $_.IsFramework -and $_.Name -notmatch '^(Microsoft|Windows)\.' -and $_.InstallLocation })
  foreach ($pt462pk in $pt462pkgs) {
    $pt462dn = ''
    try { $pt462dn = (Get-AppxPackageManifest $pt462pk -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Package.Properties.DisplayName } catch { }
    if (-not $pt462dn -or $pt462dn -match '^ms-resource') { $pt462dn = ($pt462pk.Name -replace '\.', ' ') }
    $pt462rows += ((Clean462 $pt462dn) + '|XBOX||' + (Clean462 $pt462pk.InstallLocation)); $pt462nXbox += 1
  }
} catch { }
try {
  $pt462steamRoot = 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam'
  $pt462libs = @($pt462steamRoot)
  $pt462vdf = Join-Path $pt462steamRoot 'steamapps\libraryfolders.vdf'
  if (Test-Path $pt462vdf) { foreach ($pt462m in [regex]::Matches((Get-Content $pt462vdf -Raw), '"path"\s+"([^"]+)"')) { $pt462libs += ($pt462m.Groups[1].Value -replace '\\\\', '\') } }
  foreach ($pt462lib in $pt462libs) {
    $pt462apps = Join-Path $pt462lib 'steamapps'
    if (Test-Path $pt462apps) {
      foreach ($pt462acf in @(Get-ChildItem $pt462apps -Filter 'appmanifest_*.acf' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
        $pt462raw = Get-Content $pt462acf.FullName -Raw
        $pt462nm = [regex]::Match($pt462raw, '"name"\s+"([^"]+)"'); $pt462id = [regex]::Match($pt462raw, '"installdi[r]"\s+"([^"]+)"')
        if ($pt462nm.Success) { $pt462ip = ''; if ($pt462id.Success) { $pt462ip = Join-Path (Join-Path $pt462apps 'common') $pt462id.Groups[1].Value }; $pt462rows += ((Clean462 $pt462nm.Groups[1].Value) + '|STEAM||' + (Clean462 $pt462ip)); $pt462nSteam += 1 }
      }
    }
  }
} catch { }
try {
  $pt462man = 'C:\ProgramData\Epic\EpicGamesLauncher\Data\Manifests'
  if (Test-Path $pt462man) {
    foreach ($pt462it in @(Get-ChildItem $pt462man -Filter '*.item' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
      try { $pt462j = Get-Content $pt462it.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $pt462pn = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($pt462j.LaunchExecutable); $pt462rows += ((Clean462 $pt462j.DisplayName) + '|EPIC|' + (Clean462 $pt462pn) + '|' + (Clean462 $pt462j.InstallLocation)); $pt462nEpic += 1 } catch { }
    }
  }
} catch { }
try {
  $pt462ea = 'C:\Program Files\EA Games'
  if (Test-Path $pt462ea) { foreach ($pt462f in @(Get-ChildItem $pt462ea -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { $pt462rows += ((Clean462 $pt462f.Name) + '|EA||' + (Clean462 $pt462f.FullName)); $pt462nEa += 1 } }
} catch { }
$pt462games = Join-Path $pt462dir 'games.txt'
$pt462rows = @($pt462rows | Select-Object -Unique | Select-Object -First 400)
Set-Content -Path $pt462games -Value $pt462rows
Write-Output ('CATALOG xbox=' + $pt462nXbox + ' steam=' + $pt462nSteam + ' epic=' + $pt462nEpic + ' ea=' + $pt462nEa + ' total=' + $pt462rows.Count)
$pt462old = @(Get-Process -Name 'PhiTerminal' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
foreach ($pt462o in $pt462old) { Stop-Process -Id $pt462o.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output ('PANEL CLOSED pid=' + $pt462o.Id) }
Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
$pt462b64 = @'

'@
$pt462src = Join-Path $pt462dir 'PhiTerminal3.cs'
[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($pt462src, [Convert]::FromBase64String(($pt462b64 -join '')))
Write-Output ('SOURCE BYTES=' + (Get-Item $pt462src).Length)
$pt462csc = 'C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe'
$pt462exe = Join-Path $pt462dir 'PhiTerminal.exe'
& $pt462csc /nologo /target:winexe /out:$pt462exe /reference:System.Windows.Forms.dll /reference:System.Drawing.dll $pt462src | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('CSC ' + $_) }
$pt462exeBytes = 0; if (Test-Path $pt462exe) { $pt462exeBytes = (Get-Item $pt462exe).Length }
Write-Output ('EXE BYTES=' + $pt462exeBytes)
$pt462pid = 0; $pt462state = 'NOT-LAUNCHED'
if ($pt462exeBytes -gt 0) {
  $pt462proc = Start-Process -FilePath $pt462exe -WorkingDirectory $pt462dir -PassThru
  Start-Sleep -Seconds 4
  $pt462check = Get-Process -Id $pt462proc.Id -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  if ($pt462check) { $pt462state = 'STANDS'; $pt462pid = $pt462proc.Id } else { $pt462state = 'EXITED' }
}
$pt462log = Join-Path $pt462dir 'phi_terminal_universal.log'
if (Test-Path $pt462log) { Get-Content $pt462log -Tail 8 | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('ULOG ' + $_) } }
Write-Output ('PHI PT462 VERDICT: LIBRARY STANDS state=' + $pt462state + ' pid=' + $pt462pid + ' games=' + $pt462rows.Count)
Write-Output 'JOB 462 DONE'
```
